turns.question: How many customers placed more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that counts customers by how many orders they placed, so I cannot give a figure for customers with more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026. The closest metrics are Orders (orders_total: all orders placed, cancelled included) and Active customers (customers_distinct: distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order), but neither counts customers by order count.
